Name: Edible Flowery Bullshit
Author: aylen13tejas
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
This is a cooking recipe for an item that may or may not be useful for combat. Since I am a beginner modder, I decided to follow [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811?tab=description]this SiTheGreat1's modding tutorial[/url][color=#f4f4f4], and included my own tweaks. It turned out OK.[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]Unlocks at:[/color]
[spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]Combat Level 3[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#f4f4f4]Ingredients:[/color]
[spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]3 Blueberry, 3 Slime, 2 Flower (Any)
[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#f4f4f4]Source:[/color]
[spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]Stardrop Saloon[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#f4f4f4]Buffs: [/color]
[spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]+10 Attack (1:32 min), +5 Defense (1:32 min), -4 Speed (0:22 min)[/color][/spoiler]

[color=#f4f4f4]Can this item be sold?[/color]
[spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]You can sell a Blob Of Flowery Bullshit to Marlon at the Adventure Shop for 150g.[/color][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Download this mod, extract, and copy into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url], extract, and copy into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40166?tab=files]Category Ingredient Display Fix[/url], extract, and copy into your Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40166?tab=files]Category Ingredient Display Fix[/url][/*]
[/list][center][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/center]
